subject.title: [Feature]: CLI command to list pending exec approval requests

question: Should the first CLI surface for pending exec approvals be read-only list/JSON output only, or should it also include resolve/respond and watch behavior through a trusted approval-runtime authority path?
rationale: The missing CLI surface is clear, but exposing pending command text and especially submitting approval decisions changes an operator security boundary that source inspection shows is authority-gated today.

options.title: Ship read-only list first
options.body: Add `pending`/`list` using `exec.approval.list`, table output, `--json`, docs, tests, and live redacted proof while leaving resolve/respond and watch for separate review.

options.title: Adopt broader CLI control
options.body: Use the active PR direction only after resolving the approval-runtime authority path, conflicts, proof, and security review for both listing and decision submission.

options.title: Defer CLI exposure
options.body: Keep pending approval inspection in current UI/MCP/backend paths until maintainers decide the CLI disclosure and control contract is worth the added surface.

recommendation.title: Ship read-only list first
recommendation.body: Add `pending`/`list` using `exec.approval.list`, table output, `--json`, docs, tests, and live redacted proof while leaving resolve/respond and watch for separate review.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest feature-history trail for the approvals CLI/docs surface and already provided concrete scoping guidance in the issue discussion.
